## Problem

What user need or pain motivates this? Describe the situation, not the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Concrete UI / behaviour sketches welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you ruled them out.

## Scope

Which area of the app does this touch (prayer, chat, wellness, reading, games, settings,
infra)?

## Additional context

Mock-ups, links, references, or related issues.
